engine: 11tanjung's signature — the full-screen cursive HERO WORDMARK scroll-scrubs scale + translateY DOWN into a small frosted-glass PILL fixed at top-centre. SAME DOM node the whole way (no swap): giant title -> shrinks + rises -> docks in a backdrop-blur pill that becomes the persistent nav mark. A readability scrim under the big title fades as it shrinks. Harvested from D_11tanjung (H1+H2; a016 full title -> a024/a028 docked pill).

measured_teardown.move: one pinned scroll-scrub maps progress 0..1 to the wordmark scale(1 -> ~0.16) + translateY(0 -> pill row, vh) + the frosted pill plate opacity(0 -> 1, appears late under the shrunk mark). The scrim under the big title fades 0.5 -> 0 over the first ~60%.
measured_teardown.cited: 11tanjung a016 (giant centred '11 tanjung') -> a028 ('11 tanjung' docked in a dark frosted squircle pill top-centre, while the next title blur-reveals in the centre).

pillScale.what: final scale of the wordmark inside the pill (~0.16 = giant -> ~190px).

pillY.what: translateY from centre to the pill row (negative = up to top-centre).

pinFactor.what: pin length = innerHeight*pinFactor (the scroll distance over which the title docks).

ease.what: the dock curve (the title shrinks fastest in the middle of the scrub).

scrim.what: a radial readability scrim under the big title that fades as it shrinks (keeps the cursive legible over a light render).

manageLenis.what: create+drive a Lenis (false if the page owns one).

entry: HeroTitleToNavPill.create(target, opts) -> { trigger, set(p), refresh, destroy }. Markup: .htp-stage > .htp-render(img) + .htp-scrim + .htp-pill(frosted plate) + .htp-mark(the moving wordmark). set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub (0 = giant centred title, 1 = docked pill).
law: Lenis -> gsap.ticker -> ScrollTrigger; ONE pinned scroll-scrub (start 'top top', end '+=innerHeight*pinFactor', pin:true, scrub:true); transform(scale, translateY) on the mark + opacity on scrim/pill + backdrop-filter on the pill (STATIC plate, not over the scrubbed render) only; GPU; NO mix-blend over the scrubbed render; NO WebGL; reduced-motion/<=820px -> docked pill shown. owns_pin TRUE.
gate_mode: the media is an behind the scrubbed title; the title/pill are DOM transforms — verify directly (the wheel gate's blank% may false-flag while the title scrubs, fps/jank are real).
proven: lab: OUR QUADRO hero — the cursive '11 tanjung' (Playfair italic, Canela-class) scroll-scrubs scale 1->0.17 (power2.inOut) + up into a frosted pill top-centre, the pill plate fading in late (pillOp 0->0.49->0.94->1) and the scrim fading over the first 60% (0.5->0) so the title stays legible over the light render. At rest = docked pill, centre cleared for the next title. Resolves Brick-1's 'title dirty over light photo' (the title leaves the centre). Probe (4x CPU throttle): 1/695 long frames (0.1%), 59.9fps.
